title: Lab 5 — Quiz 3
subtitle: Microscopy — parts of the brightfield microscope

questions.prompt: What is the microscope part labeled A (circled in red)?
questions.explanation: A = Arm: the sturdy structural backbone used for carrying the microscope.

why.A: Microscope head is labeled N — the upper portion that houses the prisms and holds the eyepieces.
why.C: Base is labeled B — the bottom support that keeps the microscope stable on a flat surface.
why.D: Illuminator (light source) is labeled H — the lamp housing that projects light up through the specimen.
